_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

drone_flights.basis: drone flights over Texas since June, more than, as KRGV reports USDA

animals_seen.basis: animals the drone flights observed, more than

drone_cases.basis: screwworm cases the drone flights found, the quote's 'no screwworm cases'

flights_july.basis: drone flights by the APHIS page last modified July 31st, over

animals_july.basis: animals observed by the same page, over

flies_weekly_m.basis: millions of sterile flies the Edinburg facility deploys a week, more than

dispersal_capacity_m.basis: millions of sterile flies a week the Edinburg facility can disperse, up to

production_projected_m.basis: millions of sterile flies a week the South Texas production plant is projected to make

facility_cost_m.basis: cost in millions of dollars of the Edinburg dispersal facility

counties_confirmed.basis: Texas counties with a confirmed detection, read October 18th

premises_confirmed.basis: Texas premises with at least one confirmed detection, read October 18th

first_case_day.basis: day of June of the first Texas confirmation

eradicated_year.basis: year the sterile insect technique helped eradicate screwworm from the United States

keys_year.basis: year of the Florida Keys outbreak the technique eliminated

wild_animals.basis: wild animals APHIS examined, more than

zone_counties.basis: counties with part of the infested zone: Brewster, Crockett, Edwards, Jeff Davis, Pecos, Presidio, Schleicher, Starr, Sutton, Terrell, Val Verde, Zapata

report_hours.basis: hours from suspicion within which a case should be reported

chiapas_year.basis: year screwworm was detected at the Chiapas checkpoint

model_uses.basis: uses the Kerrville director names for the models: livestock and wildlife surveillance; adult fly trapping; for implementing SIT

herd_drawn.basis: animals drawn on frame 7, one per thousand the drones observed, 36,000 divided by 1,000

days_since_first.basis: days from the first Texas confirmation, June 3rd, to October 18th, 2026, the reading date

capacity_share_pct.basis: the July 31st deployment as a share of the stated capacity, rounded to a whole percent; two different pages, so drawn only as two lengths, never printed as a percent

production_over_capacity.basis: projected production over dispersal capacity, a ratio of two quoted figures
